schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma – first loan
schemes.summary: Collateral-free Enterprise Development Loan for artisans in 18 traditional trades, at a concessional 5% a year.
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹1,00,000 at 5% for 18 months. A second loan of up to ₹2,00,000 for 30 months can follow after this one is repaid well.
schemes.apply_via: PM Vishwakarma portal (pmvishwakarma.gov.in) through a Common Service Centre

criteria.text: Works in one of the 18 listed traditional trades (for example Tailor/Darzi, Barber, Carpenter, Mason)
Applicant is at least 18 years old
Has completed the scheme's basic skill training (needed for the first loan)
criteria.fix: Register on the PM Vishwakarma portal and complete the 5–7 day basic training, which comes with a daily stipend.

criteria.text: Has not taken a loan under a similar self-employment credit scheme (such as PMEGP, PM SVANidhi or MUDRA) in recent years, unless the scheme's exceptions apply
criteria.fix: Check the exact rule and its exceptions on the PM Vishwakarma portal.

schemes.name: MUDRA Shishu
schemes.summary: Collateral-free loan for non-farm micro enterprises, guaranteed through CGFMU.
schemes.benefit: Up to ₹50,000, term loan or working capital, at the lender's rate.
schemes.apply_via: Any bank, NBFC or MFI branch, or online on JanSamarth / Udyamimitra

criteria.text: Income-generating non-farm micro enterprise in manufacturing, trading or services (activities allied to agriculture allowed)
Loan amount up to ₹50,000
Not in default with any bank or financial institution

schemes.name: MUDRA Kishore
schemes.summary: Collateral-free loan for non-farm micro enterprises, guaranteed through CGFMU.
schemes.benefit: Above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5 lakh, term loan or working capital, at the lender's rate.
schemes.apply_via: Any bank, NBFC or MFI branch, or online on JanSamarth / Udyamimitra

criteria.text: Income-generating non-farm micro enterprise in manufacturing, trading or services (activities allied to agriculture allowed)
Loan amount above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5 lakh
Not in default with any bank or financial institution

schemes.name: MUDRA Tarun
schemes.summary: Collateral-free loan for growing non-farm micro enterprises, guaranteed through CGFMU.
schemes.benefit: Above ₹5 lakh and up to ₹10 lakh, at the lender's rate.
schemes.apply_via: Any bank, NBFC or MFI branch, or online on JanSamarth / Udyamimitra

criteria.text: Income-generating non-farm micro enterprise in manufacturing, trading or services (activities allied to agriculture allowed)
Loan amount above ₹5 lakh and up to ₹10 lakh
Not in default with any bank or financial institution

schemes.name: MUDRA Tarun Plus
schemes.summary: For MUDRA borrowers who have repaid a Tarun loan and need more.
schemes.benefit: Above ₹10 lakh and up to ₹20 lakh, at the lender's rate.
schemes.apply_via: Any bank, NBFC or MFI branch, or online on JanSamarth / Udyamimitra

sources.title: PIB – MUDRA categories including Tarun Plus

criteria.text: Income-generating non-farm micro enterprise in manufacturing, trading or services
Loan amount above ₹10 lakh and up to ₹20 lakh
Has availed and successfully repaid a previous MUDRA Tarun loan
Not in default with any bank or financial institution

schemes.name: PMEGP – new unit subsidy
schemes.summary: Bank loan with a 15–35% margin-money subsidy for setting up a new non-farm micro enterprise.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy of 15–35% of project cost depending on category and area; project cost up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹20 lakh (business/service).
schemes.status_note: Verify: PMEGP was approved to 31 March 2026 and its continuation is being decided. Check the official portal before applying.

criteria.text: For setting up a new unit (existing businesses can't get the margin-money subsidy)
Applicant is at least 18 years old
Project cost up to ₹50 lakh for a manufacturing unit
Project cost up to ₹20 lakh for a business or service unit

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.summary: Bank loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs setting up a first (greenfield) enterprise. Eligibility is set by the scheme itself; CreditSetu never uses these details in your score.
schemes.benefit: Composite loan of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore (term loan plus working capital).
schemes.apply_via: Any scheduled commercial bank branch, or standupmitra.in

criteria.text: Borrower is SC/ST and/or a woman (scheme rule)
For a greenfield (first-time) enterprise
Loan amount from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore
Borrower is at least 18 years old
Not in default with any bank or financial institution

schemes.name: CGFMU guarantee (with MUDRA)
schemes.summary: Government credit guarantee that backs MUDRA loans, so the lender doesn't need collateral. The lender applies for it.
schemes.benefit: Collateral-free MUDRA loan; no action needed from you beyond applying for MUDRA.

criteria.text: Applies to MUDRA loans (up to ₹20 lakh)
Non-farm micro enterprise

schemes.name: CGTMSE guarantee (non-MUDRA loans)
schemes.summary: Credit guarantee to your lender for collateral-free loans to micro and small enterprises, up to ₹10 crore. Coverage is higher (90%) for women-led enterprises. The lender applies.
schemes.benefit: Ask your branch to sanction a non-MUDRA business loan under CGTMSE cover so no collateral is needed.

criteria.text: Micro or small enterprise
In manufacturing, services or trading
Credit up to ₹10 crore
